messages:
Ana (PM): heads-up — customer request landed from Zoe: they need a Terraform provider that can manage SSO + SCIM provisioning, plus published Python/JS SDKs in the marketplace. Wants clear launch criteria and an estimate. looping in @Ben and @Camila for context.

Ben (Sales): FYI customer is a mid-market HRIS provider. High urgency on SSO + SCIM. They'll consider Dedicated if we can guarantee provisioning SLA. Need estimate this week to move contract. :point_up:

Camila (Support): ticket #4231 created with initial logs. Failure mode: SCIM push errors when emails have weird chars; also see duplicate group ids. I attached sample CSV and stack traces.

Zoe (Customer): we can provide a dev tenant for integration tests. Important: delta sync (incremental) for SCIM and group->user mappings. Also we prefer SAML first, OIDC later.

Ana (PM): proposed minimal scope for Phase A: 1) terraform provider resources for org/app/ssoconfig 2) SCIM endpoints with delta support + email canonicalization 3) basic docs + acceptance tests. Phase B: SDK publishing + marketplace metadata + polish.

Dave (Eng): rough breakdown: SCIM server updates + canonicalization + rate-limits = ~2w; TF provider baseline = ~1w; SDK packaging + CI = ~3d. Need customer dev tenant and sample provisioning data. blocker: our auth APIs currently lack group-sync webhook.

Eli (DevEx): marketplace listing needs icons, sample app, and quickstart. I can own SDK packaging & CI if this is prioritized. Note: marketplace reviews take ~5 biz days and involve billing/legal checks.

Ana (PM): suggestion: split into Phase A (ship SCIM+SSO+TF provider minimal) with target 6w, and Phase B (SDKs + marketplace) after. Phase A acceptance criteria: SCIM provisioning passes 95% of customer test cases, SSO validated by security review, TF provider supports apply/destroy for ssoconfig.

Ben (Sales): customer says they'll sign MSA if Phase A is delivered by EOM. I can negotiate pilot credits for Dedicated capacity during testing.

Camila (Support): will add backlog tags: integrations, sso-scim, terraform-provider, sdk, customer-high. I'll attach test artifacts to the ticket and include reproduction steps.

Dave (Eng): I'll create a JIRA epic once PM posts the PRD. Request: Ana please include acceptance tests and sample CSVs. Who will own rollout comms + runbook?

Ana (PM): I'll draft the PRD + acceptance matrix today and create the epic. Assignments: Dave = backend/SCIM, Eli = SDK/packaging, Camila = test harness/support runbook, Ben = sales/customer coordination. @Zoe can you share the dev tenant creds by EOD tomorrow?

Zoe (Customer): will share dev tenant tomorrow AM. happy to run early canary and provide test cases. Thanks everyone! :pray:

Camila (Support): filing the handoff to product now, adding links to logs and reproduction.

Dave (Eng): noted. I'll scope spikes for group-sync hooks and add them to the epic.

Eli (DevEx): tiny note — for SDKs let's standardize on semver + include examples for TF + Node + Python in the repo. I'll add a template checklist to the PRD.

Ana (PM): thanks all — next steps: I'll post PRD + acceptance matrix + JIRA epic link in this thread. If anyone has blockers, flag them here.
